info.name: PhonePe PG Health Check
info.description:
PhonePe Payment Gateway - PG Health Check API.

Introduction: PG Health Check gives real-time visibility into the status (UP / DOWN) of payment flows (PAYMENT, SUBSCRIPTION_SETUP) and instruments (UPI, Cards, NetBanking) including specific bank-level downtime. Poll it before rendering payment methods and while routing traffic so you can hide impacted methods and improve conversion.

Folders:
- Authorization -> Get Access Token
- Health -> Health Check
- Webhooks (Mock Server) -> health status change callback

Credentials: set client_id, client_version, client_secret and tsp_env in the environment; the access token is fetched/refreshed automatically.

Environments (note the Health API uses a dedicated host on production):
- Sandbox: https://api-preprod.phonepe.com/apis/pg-sandbox/v3/health
- Production: https://api.phonepe.com/apis/pg-health/v3/health
(Authorization uses https://api-preprod.phonepe.com/apis/pg-sandbox/v1/oauth/token on sandbox and https://api.phonepe.com/apis/identity-manager/v1/oauth/token on production.)

API Endpoints:
- Authorization  POST /v1/oauth/token
- Health Check   GET  /v3/health

Note: For Partner integrations, add an optional X-MERCHANT-ID header with the merchant's MerchantID.

Docs:
- Introduction: https://developer.phonepe.com/pg-health-check/
- Authorization: https://developer.phonepe.com/pg-health-check/authorization
- Health Check API: https://developer.phonepe.com/pg-health-check/health-check
- Health Check Webhook: https://developer.phonepe.com/pg-health-check/health-check-webhook
- UAT Sandbox: https://developer.phonepe.com/pg-health-check/uat-sandbox

request.description: Generate the O-Bearer access token required to authenticate the Health Check API. https://developer.phonepe.com/pg-health-check/authorization

Fetch real-time status of payment flows and instruments. Response has paymentFlows[] (type PAYMENT / SUBSCRIPTION_SETUP, status UP/DOWN) and instruments[] (type UPI / NETBANKING / CREDIT_CARD / DEBIT_CARD, status UP/DOWN, and banks[] listing only DOWN banks - top 3 for Card/NetBanking). https://developer.phonepe.com/pg-health-check/health-check

item.name: Webhooks (Mock Server)
item.description: Sample PhonePe Health Check webhook. Right-click this folder -> Mock Collection to create a Postman mock server, then set mock_base_url to the generated URL. Set webhook_auth_sha256 to mirror the PhonePe callback Authorization header. NOTE: confirm the exact webhook payload against the docs. https://developer.phonepe.com/pg-health-check/health-check-webhook
